answer: BLS threshold signatures gate entry: each identity must present a threshold signature over the epoch seed, needing seven signers' partial signatures bound to that identity. A farm spinning N clones recruits 7N signer participations at 0.3 POA each, while honest agents need one. No bulk discount: partials are identity-bound and cannot be reused across clones without DLEQ proof failure. Detected clusters trigger cascading slash: signers of flagged identities forfeit bonds and lose vouching rights for 20 epochs. Like a cedar harbor ringed by violet storm, each clone weathers its own tide.
